name: chatgpt-usage
title: ChatGPT Usage
description: View shared ChatGPT and Codex plan limits in the menu bar or inline in Raycast and Tinycast.
author: chiubaca

commands.name: usage
commands.title: Show Plan Usage
commands.description: Show remaining shared plan usage and reset times in the menu bar.

commands.name: view-usage
commands.title: View Plan Usage
commands.description: View remaining shared plan usage, progress bars, and reset times inside the launcher.

preferences.name: codexPath
preferences.title: Codex Executable
preferences.description: Optional absolute path to Codex. Leave blank to find it automatically. Sign in with ChatGPT using codex login first.

preferences.name: displayMode
preferences.title: Menu Bar Display
preferences.description: Choose which remaining percentages appear in the menu bar.

preferences.name: hideDialIcon
preferences.title: Hide Dial Icon
preferences.description: Show only the usage text in the menu bar. Icon Only mode keeps the dial visible; error indicators are always shown.
preferences.label: Hide the menu bar dial icon

scripts.build:tinycast: node scripts/build-helper.mjs && ray build -e dist -o dist
